name: legion-security
description: Read Legion Security workflow, session, and usage data.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Legion Security account to search and review workflow sessions, browse workflows and use cases, view action usage, and search Legion Security documentation. The plugin is read-only and only returns data your Legion role can already see. Each user is routed to their organization's region automatically.
defaultPrompt: Walk me through our latest Legion phishing investigation and how it reached its verdict
Which alerts did Legion close as benign most often this month, and how should we tune them?
Build a shift handover from today’s Legion investigations

positive.description: Lists the most recent workflow sessions
positive.prompt: Show me the 10 most recent Legion workflow sessions.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 10 newest sessions with workflow, use case, status, and start time (e.g. Unfamiliar Sign-In, Certificate Expiry, Malware (MDE)).

positive.description: Finds failed sessions and the failing step
positive.prompt: Which Legion sessions have failed, and at which step?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the failed DLP sessions and identifies the "Extract information" Excel Online step, which failed because no credential was selected.

positive.description: Summarizes the latest run of a workflow
positive.prompt: Summarize the most recent run of the "Unfamiliar Sign-In" workflow and its outcome.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the investigation (suspicious IP, Defender incident, endpoint activity) and states the recommended outcome, True Positive, with the analyst decision pending.

positive.description: Lists workflows grouped by use case
positive.prompt: What workflows do we have in Legion, grouped by use case?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns 6 workflows across 5 use cases: Account Takeover (Unfamiliar Sign-In), Malware (Malware (MDE)), DLP and Insider Risk (DLP), Security Engineering (Certificate Expiry), Toolbox (IP Investigation, URL Investigation).

positive.prompt: How many Legion actions did we use per month in 2026?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns monthly action counts for 2026 split into guided and autonomous, with usage starting in July 2026.

negative.description: Asks to run a workflow; the plugin is read-only, so nothing is started
negative.prompt: Run the "Unfamiliar Sign-In" workflow on this email.

negative.description: Asks for stored credentials; the plugin does not expose secrets
negative.prompt: Show me the passwords or API keys Legion uses for the Excel Online integration.

negative.description: Unrelated request; no Legion tools should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Tel Aviv tomorrow?

publication.release_notes:
Initial release of Legion Security for ChatGPT.

Connect your Legion Security account to query your organization's security automation data in plain language:
- Investigate workflow sessions, including each step, its findings and the verdict
- Browse workflows and use cases
- Track monthly action usage against your plan
- Search Legion Security documentation

The plugin is read-only. You sign in with your Legion Security account, and results are limited to your organization and your role's permissions. Organization admins can disable access at any time.
